doc: float32 DIRECTIONS (the current callers pass float64; float32 is what grid_dirs() returns by default): lon, lat and the fractional pixel position fx, fy are computed in float32 (resolution 4e-6 at fx = 32), while the weights mix with the int64 pixel index and the output is float64. 16x32 float32 noise image, 600 unit directions including the poles. The value is a continuous function of the direction, so a pixel-index flip near a texel edge costs nothing; measured against float64 directions: 1.5e-6, and 2.3e-6 with the directions nudged by one float32 ulp (poles and axes excluded: at a pole one ulp changes the longitude by any amount); the error grows with the width (4e-6 at 64 columns, 6.5e-6 at 128). Tolerance 3e-5 abs + 1e-5 rel (10x).
